schemaBootstrap: Single schema initializer before parallel backend startup; simultaneous empty SQLite bootstrap is not certified
assertions: 100 genuine sockets admitted across two backends with invitation checks
All 100 seats receive exactly their room’s 10 unique load deltas through real Redis adapter
100 bounded load messages committed; Coin/game state unchanged
Backend SIGKILL and cross-backend authenticated same-ID retry do not duplicate message
Fresh backend restores chat receipts, blocks/mutes and selected SQLite evidence
Concurrent two-backend chat revision race commits exactly one candidate
Real primary outage fails closed, never falls back to local room writes
Actual Redis AOF kill/restart preserves chat and receipt replay in fresh process
Deleted room retains no chat archive; selected evidence is separately bounded to seven days
limitations: Short local chat workload, not sustained soak/SLO, production RPO, WAN/device or separate-host SQLite certification.
